name: @inventory/db
description: Database layer for Inventory Management System using Prisma

scripts.test: echo 'No tests configured for db package' && exit 0
scripts.migration:run: npm run build && npm run typeorm -- -d dist/src/data-source.js migration:run
scripts.migration:revert: npm run build && npm run typeorm -- -d dist/src/data-source.js migration:revert
scripts.db:seed: npm run build && dotenv -- node dist/src/seed.js
